notes.title: Development Update!
notes.content:
[p]I'm excited to announce that development on [i]Boulder Escape[/i] has resumed and it's now my main focus! Beta testing is set to begin in August 2025.[/p][p]The game is currently undergoing a full UI and environment overhaul. While the visuals are getting slightly tweaked, the core gameplay and overall vibe will stay true to the original. Check out the attached screenshots for a look at the new path designs and upgrade UI.[/p][p]Don’t worry, there are no in-app purchases or ads (because I hate them too).[/p][p]Thanks for your support,
Morgan – Weir Games[/p]
